leadText:
Alternate World Goh (Japanese: のゴウ Alternate World Go) is a character of the day who appeared in Showdown at the Gates of Warp!. He is Goh's counterpart from the .

Alternate Goh first appeared in Canalave City, from where he and Alternate World Chloe picked up Alternate World Ash and Dawn up before heading to the Spear Pillar, having been called to do so by his regular world counterpart. He and Chloe wore special outfits, copied from the designs made by Alternate World Team Rocket, to prevent them and their Pokémon from being affected by the time reversal that was affecting the alternate Sinnoh. Alternate Goh later participated in the battle against Alternate World Team Rocket, until a power burst from destroyed his protective suit and caused him, along with every other person present, to turn younger and sent Team Rocket blasting off. Ash, Goh, , Chloe, and their alternate counterparts prayed for to stop Dialga and 's fight, which it did, allowing the two Legendary Pokémon to undo the time reversal and return all the devolved Pokémon back to normal. Alternate World Goh and regular Goh bid farewell as the latter was returned to his own world.
